caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent green glass bowl placed centrally against a plain, light beige background. The bowl is circular with a wide opening that tapers down to a narrower base. The body of the bowl is decorated with distinct textured patterns: the upper portion features a diamond or lattice pattern, while the area beneath contains vertical fluted lines. The very bottom edge of the bowl also exhibits a repeating diamond pattern. The glass shows varying shades of green, creating a sense of depth and clarity in the depiction of the material. The drawing includes subtle shadows under the rim and on the surface of the bowl to emphasize its three-dimensional form. In the lower left-hand corner, the name "John Dana" is faintly written in pencil.
title: Bowl
